title: Cisco Meraki security basics
description: Watch who changes your Meraki estate and what appears on the air. Dashboard admin activity, admin privilege changes, changes made outside the change window, rogue access points seen by Air Marshal, and a running inventory of configuration changes.

requiredData.notes: Install the Cisco Meraki Add-on for Splunk and enable the configuration change (audit), Air Marshal, and device inventory inputs. The Dashboard API key needs organisation read access.

industrySources.control: Meraki alert ↔ SNMP trap table: configuration changed, rogue AP detected
Dashboard network alerts: configuration settings changed, rogue AP detected
CIS Control 8: audit log management for network infrastructure admin activity

curationNotes: Skips UCs that read the plain 'meraki' syslog sourcetype (SC4S or direct syslog) such as URL and IDS event feeds, because the default add-on collects from the Dashboard API.
